derivation: a primitive root; properly, to lick; but used only as a denominative from H3956 (לָשׁוֹן);
def: to wag the tongue, i.e. to calumniate

occurrences.text: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.
Accuse not a servant unto his master, lest he curse thee, and thou be found guilty.
